Inspect a Channel

Source: R/channel.R
mizu_channel_info.Rd

A read-only snapshot of the channel region and the handle-local counters: ring geometry and watermarks, the free-list and open caches, and the notify signals sent to an armed async consumer.

Usage

mizu_channel_info(ch)

Arguments

ch

a channel handle from mizu_channel() (or the ch binding inside a peer expression).

Value

A list with elements name (the platform region name, kept for debugging), side, capacity, slot_size, arena_size, inline_max, spin, ready, closed, peer_pid, tx_sent, tx_published, tx_consumed, rx_consumed, rx_published, fl_entries, fl_hits, open_hits, open_misses, ledger_entries, zc_open_hits, zc_open_misses, and notify_sends.

Examples

ch <- mizu_channel(quote(mizu_recv(ch)))
mizu_channel_info(ch)
#> $name
#> [1] "/mizu_19d6_95d07ab9"
#> 
#> $side
#> [1] "host"
#> 
#> $capacity

#>

mizu_close(ch)
